text: Unakoti Rock Carvings Shaivite Pilgrimage is a celebrated destination in Kailashahar, Tripura, renowned for its heritage, unesco tentative, sculptures, pilgrimage sites. Located in the historic and scenic region of Tripura, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Tripura. The best time to plan a visit is generally October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
